SCE.S:528054: This is the residual thought in me. I move things: from low to high, and then to nowhere.
SCE.S:528120: This is the residual thought in me. I draw near to memories and play with them. Now I return to memory.
SCE.S:5281EC: This is the residual thought in me. I saw afar, saw all, and saw the past. I leave this world.
SCE.S:5282B8: This is the residual thought in me. I leap through time. My body stays; my mind travels on.
